zoe: quick heads-up — ran a sanity bringup for mosaic-13b q4_0 across A100/H100 in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. H100 prefill latency is ~25% higher at seq=512 while decode tokens/sec is ~10% higher. end-to-end $/1M tokens ends up worse on H100 due to prefill tail. chart: http://tiny/bench/chart123 :chart_with_downwards_trend:

ben: curious — did you see any kernel fallbacks or warnings in the runtime logs? was kernel selection identical across skus?

perf-bot: run created: id=run-17777, model=mosaic-13b, q=q4_0, hw=[h100,a100], regions=[us-east-1,eu-west-1], batch=1, microbatch=4

alice: skimmed the h100 logs — there are repeated lines like `kernel_choice: attention_generic_fused` at prefill steps for tokens 0-256 then a different kernel for decode. a100 picked `attention_fused_opt` consistently. looks like selector fell back when seq distribution matched our trace.

zoe: reproduction command I used:
```
./bench --model mosaic-13b --quant q4_0 --seq 512 --hw h100 --region us-east-1 --batch 1 --microbatch 4 --warmup 50 --iters 200
```
Output snippet: `prefill p50=38ms p95=120ms p99=220ms; decode tokens/sec=2100; est $/1M=12.3` (H100). A100 run: `prefill p50=30ms p95=90ms p99=160ms; decode tokens/sec=1900; est $/1M=10.9`.

raj: h100 stronger on raw matmul but sometimes kernel selector avoids specialized fused attention if workspace memory estimates differ. q4_0 changes tensor layouts and could push past heuristics. can you capture selector decisions (`RUNTIME_DEBUG=kernel_select`) and nvprof traces for the prefill window?

zoe: will run with RUNTIME_DEBUG and nvprof in us-east. also going to try forcing `--kernel-hint=attention_fused_opt` to see if that removes the prefill penalty.

ben: if forcing the kernel helps, we should add a short-term heuristic mapping qconfigs -> kernel hints for hopper until selector is patched. file a perf ticket either way. :thumbsup:

alice: also check memory fragmentation — q4_0 sometimes causes smaller tensor strides which blow up workspace rounding on h100 drivers. small change in allocator can flip kernel choice.

perf-bot: note added to run-17777: investigation_needed, assign=eng-runtime, sla=48h

zoe: next steps: 1) run nvprof + RUNTIME_DEBUG in us-east (ETA 45m). 2) force kernel hint and rerun across both skus (ETA 90m). 3) if heuristic confirmed, open eng-runtime perf ticket with logs + small reproducer (I will do).

ben: thanks — ping here when you have the forced-kernel numbers. if it's a selector bug we can backport a heuristic quickly.

zoe: noted. will post minimal reproducer link and p95/p99 table once runs finish. :spiral_notepad:
